from __future__ import annotations

import json
import statistics
import time
from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import replace
from typing import Any

from aspenops_nexus.models import EvaluationResult


payload: dict[str, Any] = {
    "ok": True,
    "communication_ok": True,
    "engine_ok": True,
    "converged": True,
    "feasible": True,
    "values": {f"v{i}": float(i) for i in range(32)},
    "units": {f"v{i}": "1" for i in range(32)},
    "violations": [],
    "diagnostics": {"nested": {"values": list(range(64))}},
    "elapsed_s": 0.01,
    "balance_residuals": {},
    "cache_source": "persistent_cache",
    "cache_hit": True,
    "request_hash": "same",
    "worker_id": 0,
}
single_hits = 2000
duplicate_hits = 1500


def old_single_materialization() -> list[EvaluationResult]:
    return [
        EvaluationResult.from_dict(deepcopy(payload)) for _ in range(single_hits)
    ]


def new_single_materialization() -> list[EvaluationResult]:
    return [EvaluationResult.from_dict(payload) for _ in range(single_hits)]


def old_duplicate_batch() -> list[EvaluationResult]:
    output = [
        EvaluationResult.from_dict(deepcopy(payload)) for _ in range(duplicate_hits)
    ]
    return [replace(item) for item in output]


def new_duplicate_batch() -> list[EvaluationResult]:
    template = EvaluationResult.from_dict(payload)
    return [template] + [deepcopy(template) for _ in range(duplicate_hits - 1)]


def measure(function: Any, repeats: int = 9) -> tuple[float, Any]:
    samples: list[float] = []
    result: Any = None
    for _ in range(repeats):
        started = time.perf_counter()
        result = function()
        samples.append(time.perf_counter() - started)
    return statistics.median(samples), result


old_single_s, old_single = measure(old_single_materialization)
new_single_s, new_single = measure(new_single_materialization)
old_batch_s, old_batch = measure(old_duplicate_batch)
new_batch_s, new_batch = measure(new_duplicate_batch)
checks = {
    "single_results_equal": [item.to_dict() for item in old_single]
    == [item.to_dict() for item in new_single],
    "duplicate_results_equal": [item.to_dict() for item in old_batch]
    == [item.to_dict() for item in new_batch],
    "single_materialization_faster": new_single_s < old_single_s,
    "duplicate_batch_faster": new_batch_s < old_batch_s,
}
result = {
    "schema": "aspenops.pool-efficiency-benchmark/v2",
    "boundary": "Pure Python cache-result materialization benchmark; not licensed Aspen solve evidence.",
    "before_seconds": {
        "single_cached_hits": old_single_s,
        "duplicate_cached_batch": old_batch_s,
    },
    "after_seconds": {
        "single_cached_hits": new_single_s,
        "duplicate_cached_batch": new_batch_s,
    },
    "speedups": {
        "single_cached_hits": old_single_s / new_single_s,
        "duplicate_cached_batch": old_batch_s / new_batch_s,
    },
    "checks": checks,
    "decision": "PASS" if all(checks.values()) else "FAIL",
}
with open("var/cache-materialization-audit/benchmark.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    json.dump(result, handle, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    handle.write("\n")
if result["decision"] != "PASS":
    raise SystemExit(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
